(734) 752-9667

From: Kurt Varricchio <kurt@kvasports.com>
Sent: Monday, December 17, 2018 12:43 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: KVA Sports Follow-up 
 
Anthony,

Enjoyed meeting you in Las Vegas at the Winter Meetings. Let me know if there’s ever anything you might need and let’s stay in touch. Also, if you get a chance, check out www.behindinthecount.com.  It’s the official website for my recently-publish Memoir, Behind in the Count: My Journey from Juvenile Delinquent to Baseball Agent.  I wrote and published it with an eye towards helping at-risk and foster youth across the country.  Hoping to change some lives!
